 026:     """
 027:     Detector for Fair Value Gaps in candlestick data.
 028: 
 029:     A basic 3-candle FVG occurs when:
 030:     - Bullish FVG: candle[i+2].low > candle[i].high (gap between candle i and i+2)
 031:     - Bearish FVG: candle[i+2].high < candle[i].low
 032: 
 033:     Extended FVGs can have multiple middle candles all moving in the same direction.
 034: 
 035:     Parameters:
 036:         - min_gap_size: Minimum gap size as fraction of price (default: 0.001 = 0.1%)
 037:         - min_gap_size_atr: Minimum gap size as multiple of ATR (default: 0.5)
 038:         - max_middle_candles: Maximum number of middle candles to consider (default: 5)
 039:         - track_fills: Whether to track gap fills (default: True)
 040:         - partial_fill_threshold: Threshold for partial fill (default: 0.5 = 50%)
 041:     """
